title: Gray Swan Launches Largest AI Red Team Event With $300,000 Prize

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock
Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A consortium of frontier labs has formed a security coalition to identify vulnerabilities in artificial intelligence through a new competition titled 'Indirect Prompt Injection: Black'. Gray Swan AI is leading the initiative alongside partners including Meta, Google DeepMind, Anthropic, and Reflection AI, offering a $300,000 prize pool in what the organizers describe as the most realistic red teaming challenge of its kind to date.

Anthropic representatives stated that the need to solve prompt injection has become urgent as autonomous AI agents are granted more capabilities. While the company has improved defenses for its Claude models over the last few years, the current industry-wide effort seeks to build a more robust ecosystem to prevent attackers from bypassing model safeguards.
